scheme_name: Harvesting Tools Assistance for Scheduled Tribes (HRT-3)
other_conditions: Assistance is available only once in five years
Equipment must be certified by ISO/BIS/ISI/Government‑Recognized organizations and purchased through an authorized dealer or imported equipment
Eligibility extends to individual farmers as well as FPOs, FPCs, FIGs, SHGs, and Cooperative Societies
benefits_summary: ST farmers receive up to 50% of the harvesting tool cost or ₹1,00,000 (whichever is lower); FPOs/FPCs/FIGs/SHGs/Co‑operative societies receive up to 75% of the cost or ₹1,50,000 (whichever is lower), with tool price capped at ₹2,00,000.
